summary.text: Chapin Rose has represented the 51st District in the Illinois Senate since 2013, after serving in the Illinois House from 2003 to 2012.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's biography, Rose was born December 27, 1973, and holds a B.S. and a J.D. from the University of Illinois.
Rose was selected for the inaugural class of the Edgar Fellows Leadership Program in 2012.
